item.title: General
item.description: General Course Policies # Online participation and course materials # Core lectures are pre-recorded; live lecture attendance is not required. Study the assigned videos and notes, complete assessments within their availability windows, and work on both the individual and team projects. The schedule also links interactive visualizations and demonstrations when available. Course-created videos, notes, assessment questions, and code are for enrolled students. Do not redistribute them outside the course without written permission.

item.title: Office Hours
item.description: Online Office Hours # Office hours are optional online help sessions. They do not replace scheduled project reviews. Joining a session # A TA announces the session in an Ed thread with the time and any focus topic. Reply with a short, specific question and what you have tried. Do not post private information, complete code, grades, or confidential project data. The TA answers in the thread when useful to the class, or sends a private meeting link when screen sharing or individual discussion is needed.
